statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is below the watch threshold while Stress remains extreme ahead of the FOMC sequence.
recommendation: Current evidence supports a low Tail reading: equities are modestly higher while oil, Treasury yields and VIX have eased; the FOMC decision and press conference remain the dominant conditional risk window.
headline: Orderly cross-asset backdrop lowers current Tail while FOMC event stress stays extreme
body: Latest verified reporting shows the Nasdaq modestly higher, with oil lower and Treasury yields easing after stronger-than-expected U.S. retail sales. Delayed Cboe data also place VIX below 17. Direct live NQ shallow-pullback, failed-retracement or session-extreme holding structure is not independently verified, so the macro shock and approaching FOMC sequence raise Stress more than current Tail.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 published hourly slots, Tail ranged from 17% to 23%. WATCH was concentrated in the prior U.S. session and returned after the retail-sales release; overnight and European hours were mostly EA_ON while Stress stayed extreme.
outlookSummary: The highest conditional Tail risk remains the FOMC decision, press conference and immediate delayed-repricing window. Strong retail sales and import prices keep rates sensitivity high, but current verified cross-asset evidence is not aligned with persistent mean-reversion failure. A two-way policy reaction would allow Tail to normalize quickly.
